notes.title: 0.7 Update - “I hav’nae got the GPU power, cap’n”
notes.notes:
Today’s update deals with performance, reducing GPU usage to less than half what it was before in many cases. We deliver a balance overhaul with a couple of item redesigns, though mostly small changes. We’ve integrated Steam Authentication, improving the security, and therefore competitive integrity, of the game. And finally, of course, many bug fixes.



Bug Fixes

Fixed Troubling sometimes appearing in the Shop

Fixed tooltip for Rebels Repository Plans not showing correct provisions bonus

Fixed Triffid Thruster, Compost Heap, Mystery Meat, Soylant Shield and Wok-It incorrectly triggering off enemy carrier devour

Fixed older saves sometimes failing to load and raising an error

Fixed incorrect tooltip description for Panic Station

Fixed rare crash that could happen when selecting to view completed tournaments

Fixed missing string table entry on Space Bucket tooltip

Fixed Mystery Meats missing image on Item Leaderboard

Fixed Emergency Measures applying its effect to all items on the carrier instead of only generators

Fixed Undo button becoming enabled when there was nothing to Undo

Fixed Undo history retaining cancelled actions

Fixed exploit that allowed YouSellAnySpaceship keeping its effect after an Undo

Fixed error when devouring a crew that was on a Triffid Thruster A tile

Fixed rocket engine PFX of the carriers not rendering correctly

Fixed error: UWarpObjectPoolWorldSubsystem::OnUndoHistoryCleared

Fixed error: UScOptionsMenu::SaveSettings

Fixed errors that were caused by special characters in usernames

Fixed crash that could occur when fusing an item and then entering battle

Fixed reaction speech still displaying when turned off in the Options menu

Fixed some tooltips not showing +/- tag before values

Fixed Autopilots effect applying to all crew instead of just pilots

Fixed error: Duplicate battle index

Fixed cooldown visuals on some spaceships not rendering correctly

Fixed error: Crew in save file were found in invalid positions

Fixed issue where systems that add buffs were not working correctly when another system that removes buffs was active

Fixed Cloning Chamber affecting all factions types instead of only Neutrals

Fixed Ion Maiden passive effect showing as red instead of green in the combat log

Fixed crash when starting a battle with an empty carrier


Balance Notes

Eating things is fun!

Devour can feel overpowered as a mechanic. This is primarily a problem with Baron Harkonion, so he’s been redesigned. We’ve also made some other small adjustments to Devour-based cargo.


Baron Harkonion

Old

Pilot Slot: 
On Battle Start: Devours itself.
On Devoured: This Spaceship permanently gains “On Attack: Gain 10 Shield.” Baron Harkonion respawns in your reserve.

New

Pilot Slot: 
On Battle Start: Devours itself.
On Devoured: This Spaceship permanently gains “On Attack: Gain 10 Shield.” Create 2 random Common Crew in your reserve.



That should bring Devour mostly in-line, though the following cargo will also be slightly revised:


Triffid Thruster

Old

Once per battle, if a Spaceship on A devours Crew: Spaceships on A permanently gain +10 Attack, and have -15% Cooldown for this Battle

New

Once per battle, if a Spaceship on A devours Crew: Spaceships on A permanently gain +5 Attack, and have -15% Cooldown for this Battle



The Peas Maker

Old

Rarity - Galactic

Price - 130

CD - 19
On Attack - Remove 6 Dread. 
On Devour - Permanently Gain +3 Dread Removal and +20 Attack
New

Rarity - Epic

Price - 90

CD - 22
On Attack - Remove 4 Dread. 
On Devour - Permanently Gain ~+4 Dread Removal and +25 Attack

Mystery Meats

Old

On Trigger: Gain 4 Provisions and 10 Shield. +4 Provisions and +10 Shield generation for each Restaurant on A. Permanently gains +4 Provisions and 10 Shield generation the first time Crew is devoured each Battle.

New

On Trigger: Gain 4 Provisions and 10 Shield. +4 Provisions and +10 Shield generation for each Restaurant on A. Permanently gains +2 Provisions and +5 Shield generation the first time Crew is devoured each Battle.


Compost Heap

Old

On Trader Enter: Gain 20 Credits. Permanently gains +5 Credits the first time Crew is devoured each Battle.

New

On Trader Enter: If you devoured a Crew of Rare rarity or higher last battle, create a random Common Crew in your reserve. 



Star Gourd 

Old

Price 20 Credits

New

Price 30 Credits


Now that we’ve perfected Devour, and definitely will not need to adjust these values again in future, we can also talk about changes to other cargo items that are seeing too high a win rate:



Fiery Phoenix 

Old

When a Generator on A’s Cooldown triggers: gain +60 Attack

New

When a Generator on A’s generates Shield: gain +50 Attack


Massive Chonker 

Old

Passive: +100 Maximum Hull for each Cargo on A

On Battle Start: Gain 3 Space Junk for each Cargo on B

New

Passive: +75 Maximum Hull for each Cargo on A

On Battle Start: Gain 2 Space Junk for each Cargo on B



Unlife Support

Old

Passive: While you have less than 50% Hull, all Spaceships in your Carrier get +10 Attack.

When you Damage yourself with an effect: All Spaceships in your Carrier get +10 Attack on their next Attack.

New

Passive: While you have less than 50% Hull, all Spaceships in your Carrier get +10 Attack.

When you Damage yourself with an effect: All Spaceships in your Carrier get +5 Attack on their next Attack.



Mixed Griller Killer

Old

Passive: +50 and -10% Cooldown for each non-Neutral Pilot in this Spaceship

New

Passive: +40 and -5% Cooldown for each non-Neutral Pilot in this Spaceship



Virus Injector 

Old

Passive: Spaceships on A do +45% Hull damage

New

Passive: Spaceships on A do +33% Hull damage



Space Ball 

Old

Attack 400-410

New

Attack 350-375



Thunderstrike 

Old

Passive: +20 Attack per Generator on A. -20 Attack per Tool on A

New

Passive: +15 Attack per Generator on A. -15 Attack per Tool on A



Temporal Flux Drive 

Old

Passive: All Spaceships in your Carrier have +5% Cooldown and +30 Attack

New

Passive: All spaceships in your Carrier have +5% Cooldown and +20 Attack



Scrap Shield 

Old

When Attacked: 33% chance to gain 30 Shield and 4 Space Junk

New 

When Attacked: 33% chance to gain 30 Shield and 2 Space Junk


Ninelives Armour Plating

Old

Passive: +400 Maximum Hull, +40 for each Mew Republick Cargo on A.

On Trigger: Repair 20 Hull, +4 for each Mew Republick Cargo on A.

New

Passive: +300 Maximum Hull, +30 for each Mew Republick Cargo on A.

On Trigger: Repair 20 Hull, +4 for each Mew Republick Cargo on A.



Warp Core 

Old

Passive: Cargo on A have -10% Cooldown

Passive: Spaceships on B get +60 Attack

New

Passive: Cargo on A have -10% Cooldown

Passive: Spaceships on B get +40 Attack


Desanguinator 

Old

Passive: Spaceship on A get +40 Attack

Whenever a Spaceship on A attacks: Receive 25 Damage

New

Passive: Spaceship on A get +35 Attack

Whenever a Spaceship on A attacks: Receive 25 Damage


Cream Engine

Old

Passive: Spaceships on A +40 Attack. Mew Republick Spaceships get +60 Attack instead.

New

Passive: Spaceships on A +30 Attack. Mew Republick Spaceships get +50 Attack instead.



That deals with the particularly strong outliers. And high rarity items should be strong. We don’t anticipate our changes to make them any less viable, but we’ll keep an eye on them. What about cargo items that are not as rare, though? We did this:



Phoenix 

Old

Whenever a Generator on A’s Cooldown triggers: Gain +20 Attack

New

Whenever a Generator on A generates Shield: Gain +20 Attack



Scrapstorm Furnace 

Old

On Trigger: Gain 5 Space Junk. Then if you have 20 or more Space Junk, deal 50 Damage.

New

On Trigger: Gain 4 Space Junk. Then if you have 20 or more Space Junk, deal 50 Damage.



Grubway 

Old

On Trigger: Gain 5 Provisions, then deal damage equal to your Provisions to the enemy Carrier.

New

On Trigger: Gain 4 Provisions, then deal damage equal to twice your Provisions to the enemy Carrier.



Assimilator Nest 

Old

Passive: If you would gain Space Junk, gain that much +3 instead.

Passive: If you would generate Energy, generate that much +2 instead.

Passive: If you would repair Hull, repair that much +10% instead.

New

Passive: If you would gain Space Junk, gain that much +2 instead.

Passive: If you would generate Energy, generate that much +2 instead.

Passive: If you would repair Hull, repair that much +10% instead.


Coalition Relic

Old

Passive: +75 Maximum Hull for each different Faction on A.

On Battle Start: Distribute an amount of random Buffs on your Carrier and/or random Debuffs on the enemy Carrier equal to 4 times the number of different Factions on A.

New

Passive: +50 Maximum Hull for each different Faction on A.

On Battle Start: Distribute an amount of random Buffs on your Carrier and/or random Debuffs on the enemy Carrier equal to 3 times the number of different Factions on A.



Void Armour 

Old

Passive: +20 Maximum Hull for each unlocked Carrier tile that is unoccupied.

New

Passive: +15 Maximum Hull for each unlocked Carrier tile that is unoccupied.


Trashgrabber 

Old

Whenever a Generator on A’s Cooldown triggers: Gain 4 Space Junk

New

Whenever a Generator on A’s Cooldown triggers: Gain 3 Space Junk



Recyclotron

Old

On Battle Start: Gain 0 Space Junk. Permanently gains a further +4 whenever you sell a Cargo for the first time in each Trader Phase.

New

Passive: +25 Maximum Hull. Permanently gains a further +25 whenever you sell a Cargo for the first time in each Trader Phase.

On Battle Start: Gain 2 Space Junk. Permanently gains a further +2 whenever you sell a Cargo for the first time in each Trader Phase.



Scrapfield Emitter

Old

Whenever a Spaceship on A with a Pilot of Rare rarity or higher attacks: gain 5 Space Junk.

New

Whenever a Spaceship on A with a Pilot of Rare rarity or higher attacks: gain 4 Space Junk.



Ok ok, that’s enough with the nerfs. We hear you. You want BUFFS. You want to feel STRONK, LIKE BULL. And you love the Grimreaper, but don’t seem to win enough with it. Well, we did this:



Grimreaper

Old

Passive: -3% Cooldown for each other Spaceship in your Carrier (up to a maximum of -50%)

New

Passive: -4% Cooldown for each other Spaceship in your Carrier (up to a maximum of -50%)



Ion Maiden

Old

Passive: The enemy Carrier takes +50% damage from Dread.

Whenever the enemy Carrier gains Dread: Remove 1 Provision from the enemy carrier.

New

Passive: The enemy Carrier takes +50% damage from Dread.

Whenever the enemy Carrier gains Dread: Remove 1 Provision and 1 Space Junk from the enemy carrier.


Bracers of Blasting

Old

On Trigger: Deal 15 Hull damage and gain 10 Shield for each Generator on A

New

On Trigger: Deal 25 Hull damage and gain 15 Shield for each Generator on A



Quantum Entity

Old

Attack 110-115 

New

Attack 140-160



Space Bucket 

Old

4 Crew Slots

Reduce Cooldown by 10% for each Restaurant in your Carrier (up to a maximum of 50%)

New

2 Crew Slots

Reduce Cooldown by 12.5% for each Restaurant in your Carrier (up to a maximum of 50%)



Dworf

Old

Pilot Slot: Passive: +50 Attack. On Attack: Remove 5 Dread from your Carrier.

New

Pilot Slot: Passive: +65 Attack. On Attack: Remove 5 Dread from your Carrier.


Mewbacca 

Old

Rarity: Epic 

Cost 70
New

Rarity: Rare (he’s still epic in our hearts, though)

Cost 55



Rebel Plans Repository

Old

Passive: Spaceships with Mew Republick Pilots gain: On Attack: Destroy 50 Shield and Gain 2 Provisions

New

Passive: Spaceships with Mew Republick Pilots gain: On Attack: Destroy 50 Shield and Gain 4 Provisions



Philosopher’s Scone

Old

On Trigger: Gain 15 Shield, +15 for each P.R.O.T.E.C.T. cargo on A

New

On Trigger: Gain 20 Shield, +20 for each P.R.O.T.E.C.T. cargo on A



Troubles

Old

On Battle Start: Apply 3 Dread to the enemy Carrier.

Whenever you damage yourself with an effect: Apply 1 Dread to the enemy Carrier. 

On Trader Enter: Create 1 Troubling in your reserve.

New

On Battle Start: Apply 3 Dread to the enemy Carrier.

Whenever you damage yourself with an effect: Apply 1 Dread to and remove 1 random Buff from the enemy Carrier.

On Trader Enter: Create 1 Troubling in your reserve.



Troubling

Old

On Battle Start: Apply 1 Dread to the enemy Carrier.

Whenever you damage yourself with an effect: 50% chance to apply 1 Dread to the enemy Carrier.

Ships on A have +5% Cooldown

New

Whenever you damage yourself with an effect: 50% chance to apply 1 Dread and remove 1 random Buff from the enemy Carrier.

Ships on A have +5% Cooldown



Bigger Troubles

Old

On Battle Start: Apply 2 Dread to the enemy Carrier for each Troubles or Troubling on A.

Whenever you Damage yourself with an effect: Apply 2 Dread to the enemy Carrier.

New

On Battle Start: Apply 2 Dread to the enemy Carrier for each Troubles or Troubling on A.

Whenever you Damage yourself with an effect: Apply 2 Dread to and remove 2 random Buffs from the enemy Carrier.



Duke Skyclawer

Old

Pilot Slot: Whenever the opponent gains Shield: Gain +2 Attack.

New

Pilot Slot: Passive: Shield Damage: +20%


Sproutnik

Old

On Attack - If you have 15 or more Dread, remove 15 Dread from your Carrier and apply 15 Dread to the enemy Carrier

New

Whenever you remove one or more Buffs from the enemy Carrier: Gain +10 Attack.
Whenever you remove one or more Debuffs from your Carrier: Gain +10 Attack


Claw-Wing

Old

On Attack: Consume 5 energy to destroy 85 shield

New

On Attack: Destroy 30 shield



And finally, two additional notes: 



MSS Terrorise has been temporarily removed from the game. It will return soon in a new form.



Wrath Of Naan also gets the recognition it deserves, as its rarity is upgraded from Common to Epic (sorry, StarScope fans)

notes.title: 0.6.8377 Update - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Today's update fixes the 'dirty particles' issue that we have been seeing since launch. Overall, it wasn't impacting players often, but it was our most frequent issue, so we are delighted to have finally resolved it, especially as it was a bug inside Unreal Chaos, and not something we were directly responsible for. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182011/9136eb5b7f148b3ede9fe9395c069097a858754f.gif"]



To put it in context, over the last 90 days, this bug occurred 309 times - the next biggest issue occurred 26 times, and that was people trying to play the game with outdated graphics drivers, so hopefully this update has removed over 70% of our major errors. 



Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue that would cause the game to crash to desktop after a battle

Fixed an issue where rerolling could reduce the charges/duration of effects that didn't affect reroll chances

Fixed an exploit related to YouSellAnySpaceship and Undo/Redo to get infinite credits

Re-balanced YouSellAnySpaceship.com to only trigger once per trader phase

Fixed an issue with StarScope affecting every item in the shop, instead of only discounting Common Spaceships

Fix for intermittent crash when loading an in-progress run

notes.notes:

notes.title: 0.6.8029 Update - New Items and features
notes.notes:
Version 8029 is live now, featuring new cargo and crew from the Humanitarians, a very useful Undo and Redo button in the Trader screen and a new ‘pop’ effect will help show when cargo items are working together. 

Comminucation Systems have all been redesigned to now have dual factions and some item rarity has been tweaked to create a more balanced start to the factions in game.

We have also rebalanced a number of items and fixed a plethora of bugs!

notes.title: Update V.7608 and the Pauper Challenge
notes.notes:
Commander, your data analysis systems have been upgraded!

After a battle, you can now study the stats of every item on your carrier and the enemies, to better understand where you can improve your configuration. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182011/0c85b803ddfdc45580f83cd10b305cd51774d637.jpg"]

Even in the Trader, you'll be able to see how your items have been performing with new tooltips. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182011/a262454365c4622b774d1f014eae10c664699974.png"]

(Although you might notice the hull and shield damage stats are currently flipped—we’ll fix this with your next software upgrade.)



And what better way to test out these new features than a new Single Player Event - the Pauper Challenge! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182011/85e248f49aa58117237cee420e772300df39c6d1.png"]



Version 7608 Patch notes: 

Added a Battle Stats menu to show how items performed in the battle. Available on the results screen after a battle.

Added 'Current Battle Stats' to the tooltip for each item on your carrier when in Battle.

Added 'Previous Battle Stats' to the tooltip for each item on your carrier when in the Trader.

Fixed an issue with the Find Me button not working in leaderboards

Updated the battle log to use the Player's username instead of 'SC##'

Updated a number of elements in the combat log to make it more readable.

Added an indicator to the Main Menu when there is a new tournament result to view.

Fixed an issue with carrier previews appearing blurry

Fixed an issue with tooltip UI sometimes being cut off at the bottom of the screen.

Added the Season number to the Warp Mode button.

Rebalanced a number of items

Fixed an issue that was preventing fused items from appearing on the leaderboards

Fixed an issue with 'Invalid Tournament State'

... and a bunch of other bug fixes.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Release Date

Commander! Glad you could make it! Your carrier is nearly ready. We are just running some final checks to make sure we've fixed that rapid unscheduled disassembly issue your predecessor mentioned briefly. 
Your scheduled launch date is May 7th, 3PM CET, Earth. I'll leave you to calculate the relative time for your location in space. 
 - Admiral Quckbar 


Competition Announcement

To celebrate the launch of Konfronto, we are kicking off with a unique competition where you can win a chance to design your very own in-game Character for a future update.

Season 1 of Warp Mode is the place to be, and anyone completing a run of 10 wins with ZERO losses can submit their Carrier into a 10-0 Prize Tournament, which will take place at the end of the season (9am UTC May 19th).

The Grand Champion will work with our art team to immortalise their own character design into the game, it could even be based on your own face!

notes.title: Konfronto Press Release
notes.notes:
PRESS RELEASE

Flaming Fowl are excited to announce their new project, Konfronto. A sci-fi auto battler, pack filled with more parodies and puns than an episode of Red Dwarf.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182011/33d71b66080e891593ff70639ba3408287fe836f.png
Take command of your own intergalactic carrier, upgrading it with a wide array of deadly spaceships and weird and wonderful technology designed to obliterate anyone foolish enough to oppose you in asynchronous multiplayer. 

The position of your cargo items can trigger awesome combos with each other or combine to create entirely new technology. Hire crew to uncover rewards hidden in derelict areas of your Carrier then put them to work flying your starships. 

All of this results in billions of possible combinations, meaning that each run will always be different.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182011/b3ad25a1a31fa2adb0f4036c882ca53e79804030.png

[strike]Craig Oman, CEO of Flaming Fowl Studio, said about the announcement: “Oh my god, why did I get into this industry?! I should have listened to my mum and got a real job…”[/strike]

[we can't use that - just put a funny picture in instead] 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182011/40e4feba6271722e3486e479c1b8b14611f30061.png

Konfronto is available to wishlist on Steam now and will have a demo available at the Steam NextFest in October.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2994150

Creative Director, Mike West, highlighted the importance of the Steam event “NextFest is a huge opportunity for devs that are self-publishing like ourselves, we really hope the community enjoys what we have made, or at the very least they pretend to enjoy it if they are streaming.”


Links: Steam, Discord, Facebook, Twitter (I’m still not calling it X)

About the Developer
Flaming Fowl Studios is an independent game studio, rising from the ashes of the renowned Lionhead Studios, and previously developed Gloomhaven. Our company goal is to build deep and interesting strategic experiences with fascinating twists and a healthy dose of humour. We also aim to include our fans and customers in the development process and by working together we hope to create something special.

About the Publisher
Eh well it’s just us again actually. Most publishers seem to be hibernating this year so we figured we would just do it ourselves. It doesn’t seem that hard so far, you just have to write the occasional press release and not say anything stupid.
